note:
project and hr_holidays: 222 -> 206, sixteen hooks named for one of the fields they serve, plus three free-standing domains that did not say so first.

addons/project, twelve. Seven computes serve several fields and were named for one: _compute_task_count on project.project (task_count, open_task_count, closed_task_count) and on project.milestone (task_count, done_task_count), _compute_risk_count (risk_count, high_risk_count), _compute_subtask_count and _compute_predecessor_count on project.task, project.risk._compute_risk_score (risk_score, risk_level), and _compute_next_milestone_id, which serves next_milestone_id, can_mark_milestone_as_done and is_milestone_deadline_exceeded. Two named a field that does not exist: _compute_project_task_opened_value serves kpi_project_task_opened_value and _compute_total_update_ids serves update_count. Three return a domain and are free-standing, so ADR-0054 spells them _get_domain_<what>: _get_profitability_aal_domain, _get_projects_to_make_billable_domain, _get_attachments_search_domain.

addons/hr_holidays, four, all the same shape: _compute_allocation_count (allocation_count, allocations_count), _compute_allocation_remaining_display (allocation_display, allocation_remaining_display), _compute_supported_attachment_ids (supported_attachment_ids and its _count), _compute_is_hatched (is_hatched, is_striked).

Two of those are the convention case rather than the collision case. _compute_is_hatched is declared on four models -- hr.leave plus timesheet_grid, social and planning -- and the three enterprise ones serve exactly one field each and are correct; only hr.leave had hung a second field off it. _compute_allocation_count is the same, correct on hr.leave.type and doubled on hr.employee. So both renames are scoped to the doubled owner and restore the spelling for the correct siblings rather than breaking it.

Measured tip and parent in a detached worktree.
